design_decisions.question: Unwrap Expr::Reference as well as Expr::Paren on the assignment target, matching CALL's own value-read unwrap_value_read helper?
design_decisions.decision: No -- unwrap_parens only (Paren, not Reference), exactly as unwrap_parens's own doc comment specifies for this position. `&y = 5;` is not legal Rust (a reference is never an assignable place), so unwrapping a Reference here would be recognizing a shape that cannot occur in valid source, not closing a real gap.
